segments.name: Human Capital Management
segments.description: Distributes and implements human capital management software and consulting for clients in Malaysia and Singapore.
segments.evidence: The Group operates as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay the company for software licences or SaaS subscriptions, plus consulting, implementation, training and maintenance.
revenueModel.evidence: Clients buying licensing generally also engage the Company for consultancy, implementation, and maintenance services.
